The part you don't see

Good tile starts underneath.

A shower only looks good for years if what's behind it is done right. That's the part we don't rush.

  • Waterproofed first. Shower walls and pans are sealed with a waterproof membrane before any tile goes on.
  • Flat, even tile. Big tiles are set with a leveling system so edges line up and stay flat.
  • Clean job site. Floors and finished work are covered while we work.
